A newline inside two nested spans still separates the words on either side

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>Alpha<span><span>\n</span></span>Beta</p>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
